sentences.text: Raggedy Ann is a character created by American writer Johnny Gruelle -LRB- 1880 -- 1938 -RRB- in a series of books he wrote and illustrated for young children .	Johnny Gruelle	Johnny Gruelle	character	character (arts)

The character was created in 1915 as a doll , and was introduced to the public in the 1918 book Raggedy Ann Stories .	character	character (arts)
When a doll was marketed with the book , the concept had great success .
